name: io.github.tonyyang0504/meta_shops-mcp
description: Facebook & Instagram Shops (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing, lis

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_META_SHOPS_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: System-user (or long-lived user) access token of a Meta app with catalog_management and, for orders, commerce_account_manage_orders / commerce_account_read_orders permissions on the commerce account; sent as Authorization: Bearer.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_META_SHOPS_CATALOG_ID
environmentVariables.description: Product catalog id (Commerce Manager > Catalog > Settings).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_META_SHOPS_CMS_ID
environmentVariables.description: Commerce account (CMS) id; required for list_orders.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_META_SHOPS_CURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: ISO currency of the catalog prices, e.g. USD; required when update_listing sends a price ('9.99 USD').
